name: drupal-ui-regression
description: Read-only Drupal Paragraph visual regression CLI

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/discovery.test.js tests/match.test.js tests/compare.test.js tests/report.test.js tests/dom.test.js tests/cli.test.js tests/ui.test.js tests/browser-auth.test.js tests/sso-ui.test.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src ui fixtures tests scripts configs schemas *.md .github .prettierrc.json package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src ui fixtures tests scripts configs schemas *.md .github .prettierrc.json package.json
